ablation_protocol: Grouped development CV with the primary frozen SVM settings.

joint_representation.protocol: Post-hoc grouped development CV with primary frozen SVM settings; the official test subjects are not used.

desynchronization_control.construction: Derange the 98 gyroscope delay points within each window after separate block normalization. Both marginal point clouds are unchanged; only cross-sensor pairing is removed.

coupled_max_representation.protocol: Post-hoc grouped development CV with primary frozen SVM settings; the official test subjects are not used.
coupled_max_representation.construction: For paired normalized delay clouds, use the maximum of the weighted acceleration and gyroscope distances. At equal weight, an edge appears exactly when both marginal distances are at most the filtration threshold.
